name: ryze-ai
description: Marketing tool for SEO, GEO and paid ads: Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok and LinkedIn Ads, Analytics 4, Search Console, Drive, Shopify and WordPress.

interface.longDescription:
Ryze AI connects ChatGPT to the marketing accounts you already use: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Drive, Shopify and WordPress. Audit, report on and improve your SEO, GEO and paid ads from one conversation.

Paid ads:
- Account summaries and campaign, ad group, ad and keyword performance with spend, CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS
- Search terms, optimization recommendations, and keyword ideas with search volume and bid ranges
- Changes you confirm: pause or activate campaigns, ad sets and ads, change budgets and bids, add keywords and negative keywords, apply or dismiss recommendations
- Competitor research in the public Meta Ad Library

SEO and GEO:
- Search Console queries and pages, URL inspection and sitemaps
- Google Analytics 4 traffic by channel, landing pages, key events and realtime users
- Traffic arriving from AI search assistants, by source and landing page
- Shopify and WordPress: update SEO titles and descriptions, product descriptions, articles and draft posts

Reporting:
- Write results to Google Sheets and Docs
- Schedule recurring reports delivered by email

Every tool has a fixed, typed input for one specific task. Read tools only read. Changes run with the permissions of the accounts you connected, and ChatGPT asks before anything is overwritten, deleted or published.

Requires a Ryze AI account with at least one marketing platform connected.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Google Ads account for the last 30 days
Which Meta Ads campaigns had the best CPA last month?
What are my top Search Console queries this month?

positive.description: Google Ads account summary: the app finds the non-manager Google Ads account and summarizes its last 30 days.
positive.prompt: Summarize my Google Ads account performance for the last 30 days: spend, clicks, impressions and conversions.
positive.expected_behavior: google_ads_list_accounts returns two accounts named "Pantio": 4265059696 (not a manager) and 9933819268 (manager). The app summarizes 4265059696 for the last 30 days: impressions, clicks, cost, conversions and CTR, with currency USD, time zone America/Los_Angeles and 4 campaigns. It is a low-activity sample account, so the metrics are zero.

positive.description: Meta Ads campaign performance for the last 30 days, as a table.
positive.prompt: Show my Meta Ads campaigns in the Ryze Core ad account for the last 30 days with spend, clicks, CPA and ROAS, as a table.
positive.expected_behavior: meta_ads_list_ad_accounts returns three ad accounts: Ryze Core, Dmitry Korzhov and Pantio. The app runs meta_ads_get_performance on Ryze Core at campaign level and shows a table of its campaigns (for example seo-scan-broad and paid-ads-ugc) with spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPA and ROAS, plus account totals.

positive.description: SEO monitoring: top Search Console queries for the user's own site.
positive.prompt: Show the top 10 Search Console queries by clicks for sc-domain:get-ryze.ai over the last 28 days.
positive.expected_behavior: The site list includes sc-domain:get-ryze.ai. The app returns a table of 10 queries with clicks, impressions, CTR and average position; the top query is "ryze ai", followed by other branded queries such as "ryze" and "ryze ai login".

positive.description: GEO tracking: traffic from AI search assistants, from Google Analytics 4.
positive.prompt: How much traffic did the get-ryze-ai Google Analytics property get from AI search assistants in the last 30 days, by source?
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the property "get-ryze-ai" (505794376) in the account "Ryze AI" and returns AI-referred sessions and users for the last 30 days broken down by source, with the total, the prior-period total and the percent change.

positive.description: Write results to Google Sheets: create a new sheet in the connected Drive and add a row to it.
positive.prompt: Create a new Google Sheet named 'Reviewer Test' and add a row with today's date and the words 'reviewer test'.
positive.expected_behavior: The app creates an empty Google Sheet named "Reviewer Test" in the connected Drive, appends one row with the date and "reviewer test" to it, confirms the updated range (for example Sheet1!A1:B1) and returns the sheet link. Both are write actions, so ChatGPT asks for confirmation first.

negative.description: Generic marketing copywriting that needs no account data.
negative.prompt: Write 5 Instagram caption ideas for a coffee brand launch.

negative.description: Industry benchmark question answered from general knowledge, not the user's data.
negative.prompt: What is the average click-through rate for search ads across industries?

negative.description: Image editing; the app has no image generation or editing tools.
negative.prompt: Edit this product photo to look more premium for my ad.

review.commerce_description: Ryze AI does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release on the Ryze tools server: typed tools for Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Drive, Shopify and WordPress. OAuth sign-in. Every tool sets all four hints (read-only, destructive, idempotent, open world) explicitly.
